name: EightyTwentyAnalysis
description: Conducts an 80/20 analysis of features and creates point clusters, lines, or polygons based on the number of associated incidents. The tool calculates a cumulative percentage field to identify the locations where incidents are disproportionately occurring.

parameters.name: inputLayer
parameters.description: The input point features that will be used to create clusters, lines, or polygons.

parameters.name: aggregationMethod
parameters.description: Specifies how the input point features will be aggregated.

parameters.name: clusterTolerance
parameters.description: The maximum distance separating points at which they will be considered part of the same cluster.

parameters.name: inComparisonFeatures
parameters.description: The comparison input polygon or line feature class by which the input point features are aggregated.

parameters.name: matchFields
parameters.description: Pairs of fields from the input point features and input comparison features that will be used for attribute matching.

parameters.name: outFields
parameters.description: The fields from the input features that will be transferred to the output.

parameters.name: outputName
parameters.description: Additional properties such as output feature service name.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Additional settings such as processing extent and output spatial reference.
